title: A new dioxo-molybdenum complex derived from an amide-based imine derivative for the fluorescence recognition of Zr(IV) with phosphatase activity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11130-11136
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04804D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amit Kumar De, Tandrim Shaym, Subhasis Ghosh, Sunanda Dogra, Angshuman Roy Choudhury, Debasis Das
An amide-imine (DBASL)-based Mo(VI) complex selectively recognizes ZrO2+ via sky-blue emission having LOD of 23.1 nM. The DBASLM efficiently catalyses the hydrolysis of the phospho-ester bond in p-NPP.
